atAGlance: Lẩu Thái is Vietnamese Thai-style hot pot, usually with sour-spicy broth, seafood or meat, greens, and noodles.
whatItIs: Lẩu Thái is Thai-style hot pot as adapted in Vietnam: sour-spicy broth with lemongrass, lime leaf, tomato, pineapple, seafood or meat, greens, mushrooms, and noodles.
howToEnjoy: Cook seafood or meat first, add greens in waves, and save noodles for later so they do not turn soft. Ask for less spicy before the broth is set.
howLocalsOrder: Order lẩu Thái by table size and choose seafood, meat, or mixed toppings if asked. Say ít cay if you want sour lemongrass flavor without heavy heat.
worthKnowing: Vietnamese lẩu Thái is popular for group meals because the sour-spicy broth wakes up seafood, beef, vegetables, and noodles.
goodToKnow: Choose portion size first, then protein and spice level. Say ít cay before the broth is set if you want sour lemongrass flavor with less heat.
